The Privileged users overview displays the trend line for the privileged users (active and inactive) and their activity on the Now Platform. Privileged users are users who have been assigned additional roles by admins to access the features like High Security Settings, Import, Portal users, and so on.
Total privileged users
It displays the trend line of the total users on the Now Platform.
Total users
Active privileged users
It displays the trend line of active users on the Now Platform.
Active users
Inactive privileged users
It displays the trend line of inactive users on the Now Platform.
Inactive users
Privileged inactive users who are not locked out

It displays the trend line about the inactive users who are not locked out on the Now Platform. Locked out users are users who are logged out of the Now Platform for a long time and cannot login again.
Inactive users who are not locked out
New privileged users
It displays the trend line for new users added to the Now Platform.
New users
Privileged users successful logins
It displays the trend line of your users' successful logins on the Now Platform.
Successful logins
Privileged users failed logins

It displays the trend line about locked out users on the Now Platform.
Locked out users

Users never logged in
